csv_project_name: AE for NM Navajo Code Talkers Museum
csv_agency: State of New Mexico Purchasing Div/GSD
csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of the Request for Proposal (RFP) is to solicit sealed proposals to establish a contract through competitive negotiations for the procurement of Architect/Engineer services for the development of the Navajo Code Talker Museum (Museum) located on the Navajo Preparatory School campus in Farmington, New Mexico. The Scope of work for A/E Services encompasses complete A/E services, including necessary site development, for all design phases from programming through construction administration, close out, and 11-month warranty, as well as interfacing with the chosen Exhibition Design Firm to integrate the core exhibit into the building. The core exhibit to be housed in this museum will be approximately 6500 SF. Specialty Sub-consultants shall include a Museum Specialist with professional experience in exhibit planning and museum design as well as a Navajo Code Talker Subject Matter Expert (SME) with deep knowledge of Code Talker history and the Din people, and ideally has existing relationships with the Code Talker families or the Navajo Code Talkers Association.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
